revision: r19 round (2026-11-02): tiny-band extra positive regression supervision; third arm restored as the count-matched band mass control; preparation only, no GPU
positioning: practical initial screening of band-conditioned extra regression positives inside a frozen one-to-one NMS-free DETR (regression only, inference untouched); one-to-many positive assignment is a known family (dense/anchor-based positive assignment, auxiliary one-to-many heads); no originality claim

endpoint.note: unchanged fixed endpoint and scoring policy; no selection, no tuning

acceptance.note: one launch, at most 4 unique optimizer updates in total; stop on anomaly; the acceptance state is not usable for the formal training

gates.units: differences in percentage points (100 x (lhs - rhs))

A2_minus_A0.meaning: practical single-seed net benefit of the tiny-band extra positive supervision against the native arm at the fixed starting point and short schedule

A2_minus_A1.meaning: method-contribution reading: the information in admitting an additional real, geometrically supported box, against the count-matched band mass control that duplicates the native matched band pair instead

combination.note: single seed only; no multi-seed, no follow-on round, no metric-level selection, and no originality claim from a pass; the practical verdict is A2-A0 and the contribution reading is A2-A1

frozen_science.mechanism: inside every non-denoising loss_boxes call the positive set handed to the frozen native loss is augmented with one extra regression-only pair per tiny-band ground-truth box: the highest-overlap UNMATCHED query whose overlap clears IOU_TAU and whose own best-overlapping ground-truth box is that box; the extra pair carries the native L1 and native 1-GIoU at the native per-pair scale under the native keys; num_boxes, VFL, matcher, DN families, anchors, selection rule and inference are untouched; zero parameters and zero new loss keys
frozen_science.control: A1 duplicates the native matched pair of every tiny-band ground-truth box in the same regression positive set: same plumbing, same extra-pair count, same normalisation, no new geometric information and no wrong supervision
frozen_science.band: raw canvas area <= 1024 px^2 on the 768x1344 canvas (normalized area <= 1024/1032192), the same band as the D1 diagnostic and the r18 round; note this canvas-area band is different from the original-image-area APS grouping
frozen_science.regression_only: the extra pairs receive no classification target, so the one-to-one score semantics and the NMS-free output are unchanged; the direct beneficiary box is normally discarded at inference and the declared in-training prediction is that the band's MATCHED pair improves (audited by pos_band_native_iou_sum and pos_band_pairs per family call)
frozen_science.training_budget: 3,648 updates per arm, three arms (A0 native, A1 mass control, A2 method), fixed endpoint FT012 EMA-C, no selection and no tuning
frozen_science.schedule_justification: zero new parameters and no new module: the mechanism's gradient path is live from the first update, so the established 12-pass e120 platform measures the direction of the effect; an earlier start or a longer schedule is a separate question and is not used here

storage_declaration.note: whole-round declaration for this round directory only; every preparation material of the earlier rounds stays where it is and is not duplicated
